summary: Deduplicated discussion signals about agent security, parallel workflows, memory/sandbox failures, and infra tooling; prioritizes vendor incidents (Anthropic, Microsoft), operator workflows, and infra primitives needing corroboration. | Vendor updates: Anthropic product/engineering posts (Opus 5, containment, MHS preview) and multiple infra primitives (AWS Bedrock memory, Modal sandboxes, Supabase MCP) with Cloudflare, Vercel, Daytona product moves and a JetBrains security incident. No social/operator field reports found — several single-source packages need corroboration.
